$comment: Live-seam allow list (W11.I1, R4.1). Every register*/set* hook in src/ with no production caller must be listed here with its kind (pending | test-only | dead), the plan task that closes it, the reason, and an expiry date (YYYY-MM-DD, at most 183 days ahead). An expired entry fails `npm run hygiene`, as does a stale one (the seam is live now, or gone). Read by scripts/lib/liveSeams.mjs.
